body: @Jianzhu91 before looking into this can you please upgrade your netty version to the latest 4.1 release and let me know if you still see the issue ?
@normanmaurer I just try again with the Netty 4.1.16.Final version. That issue still happens.
@Jianzhu91 ok will check once I find some cycles.

@Jianzhu91 can you give me a few more details about this. I inspected the code and I think we should only fire and `SslHandshakeCompletionEvent` event in this case and notify the pending writes. Where exactly do you see the error ? Is it in an `exceptionCaught(...)` callback or a `ChannelFutureListener` ?

@normanmaurer  I add a handler before `SslHandler` to close the channel when necessary.  What we want to do is to close the channel before `SSL` handshake. However, when you close the channel, the `channelInactive()` method is invoked and throws the `java.nio.channels.ClosedChannelException` (logs in the Actual Behavior section above). it's not in the `exceptionCaught(...)` or `ChannelFutureListener`. At the same time, an `SslHandshakeCompletionEvent` is fired, and notify us the failure of `SSL` handshake. We have our channel tracker to track the status of `SSL` handshake. I expect that we should not receive any exceptions and the `SslHandshakeCompletionEvent`, since the `SSL` handshake has not started.
@Jianzhu91 so just to clarify you log it via the `SslHandshakeCompletionEvent` which you think should not be fired at all ?
@normanmaurer Yes. I expect `SslHandshakeCompletionEvent` should not be fired. From my understanding, SSL handshake should not starts if we add a handler before SslHandler to close the channel.

issue.title: Dont fire an SslHandshakeEvent if the handshake was not started at all.

repository.name: netty
repository.description: Netty project - an event-driven asynchronous network application framework

issue.body:
Motivation:

We should not fire a SslHandshakeEvent if the channel is closed but the handshake was not started.

Modifications:

- Add a variable to SslHandler which tracks if an handshake was started yet or not and depending on this fire the event.
- Add a unit test

Result:

Fixes [#7262].
